name: Ifrit Blacksmith (CR 7)
body:
The ifrit blacksmith, muscular and taller than most men, finishes her craft before turning to you with an infectious smile.

XP 3,200
Female lavasoul ifrit geomancer 8
LN Medium outsider (native)
Init -1; Senses darkvision 60 feet, sense spirits and elements; Perception +8 (guardian spirits +3)

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 9, flat-footed 14 (+5 armor, -1 Dex)
hp 54 (8d6+24)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +11
Defensive Abilities +2 racial bonus on saves vs. fatigue and exhaustion, fire in the blood (heal up to 14 points per day via fire damage), fire resistance 5, guardian spirits +3, spiritual guidance

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 dwarven giant-sticker +8 (2d6+5/x3)
Melee sledge +7 (2d6+5/x2)
Special Attacks rebuke spirit 4d6 (Will DC 18 negates; 7/day)
Geomancer Spells Prepared (CL 8, +1 for spells with earth or fire descriptor or with “walls” in its name; concentration +12; attuned element: fire, complimentary element: earth or metal)

4th (4/day)-gravel vortex*, spiritual ally
3rd (5/day)-greater thunderstomp (CMB +12), heroism, shield of wings
2nd (5/day)-molten orb, protection from outsiders, spiritual squire, spiritual weapon
1st (5/day)–ancestral communion, deadeye’s lore, expeditious construction, produce flame, remove fear
Cantrips–detect magic, employ elements, firebolt**, flare, light, purify food and drink, root, spark (DC 14)

Spell-like Abilities (CL 8th; concentration +12)

At will–DR x/adamantine for 1 minute, where x is equal to highest qualifying spell*; vertical stone or energy wall composed of contiguous 5-ft. squares equal to 2x the highest qualifying spell**

TACTICS

Before Combat If The ifrit blacksmith suspects the attackers are skilled at dealing physical damage, she will activate the Earth’s Embrace feat to protect her from injury. Otherwise, she starts laying down walls with the Mason of Walls feat as barriers or cover.

During Combat The ifrit blacksmith is not afraid to throw down with melee attackers if necessary but her preference is to support her allies as a ranged damage dealer (with spells like produce flame or spiritual weapon) or utilizing battle field control.

Morale The ifrit blacksmith will do her best to keep her allies alive but if her life is at serious risk, she has no qualms with retreating to the safety of the skies or withdrawing from combat. She will use her potions of cure light wounds on herself as needed.

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 8, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 18, Cha 12
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 16
Feats Beloved by the World*, Earth’s Embrace**, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dwarven giant-sticker), Mason of Walls**
Skills Craft (armor) +7, Craft (weapon) +7, Diplomacy +5, Heal +9, Knowledge (arcana) +6, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +5, Knowledge (engineering) +5, Knowledge (geography) +4, Knowledge (nature) +6, Knowledge (planes) +6, Knowledge (religion) +6, Perception +8, Profession (blacksmith) +9, Sense Motive +6, Spellcraft +8, Survival +5
Languages Common, Dwarven, Ignan
SQ elemental mastery (fire +1), elemental speak, forgehardened, spiritual boon (wind)
Gear sledge, +1 dwarven giant-sticker, potion of cure light wounds (2), bag of minor holding, belt of giant strength +2, +1 lamellar cuirass, cloak of the hedge wizard (transmutation), gloves of improvised might +1, traveler’s any-tool, headband of inspired wisdom +2, utilitarian rod, ring of sustenance, ring of resistance +1, spell components, 1 week of trail rations, assorted coins and gems worth 100 gp, adventurer’s sash, backpack, waterskin, artisan’s outfit, explorer’s outfit

* Bul-soo keeps one prepared gravel vortex available to use her reserve feats at maximum potential.

** Spell from Read Magic – The Compilation by Orphaned Bookworm Productions

* See Earth’s Embrace feat

** See Mason of Wall feat.
